The *Pārāvatajātaka* (Ja 395), titled *The Dove* in English translation, is a canonical birth story in the Jātaka collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. According to the traditional framework recorded in the text's opening, the Buddha delivered this discourse while residing at Jetavana monastery in Sāvatthī, prompted by the conduct of a greedy monk [SuttaCentral]. The narrative opens with the verse phrase "Our old friend" [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral catalogs four modern translations of the text in four languages [SuttaCentral].
